name: hud_stack_late_press_partner_latency_3
description: A press late in a build window online, at 3 turns of latency each way (150 ms), in High Water with a partner who never calls (M8's review; design 2.7 and 5.7). An order lands later than offline: after the turns the game holds and has not run yet (TurnSource.order_lead) by its trip there and back (MatchClient.rtt_ms in whole turns: Game.order_trip), and the horn's question counted only the first, so a press with more of the countdown left than the order's lead and a turn went out at once, landed after the window's horn and was taken as a call for wave 2: beside a partner it stood as a call ('Ready 1/2') and carried into the next window. Now the press asks for a second and sends nothing. And a READY no question held back (as when the trip lengthens after it was measured) names the window's wave, wave 1, so landing in wave 1 it is refused WRONG_PHASE, unsaid: wave 1 walks alone and no call stands, so none carries into window 2.

steps.assert: Game.sim.hollows[0].countdown_t > lead + 3 and Game.order_trip() == 18 and Game.late_in_window()
steps.msg: more of the window left than the order's lead and a turn, less than those and the 18-tick trip

steps.assert: scene.controller.call_armed() and node('Notice').text == 'Call wave 2 now? Press again' and scene.settled() and node('LoopbackMain').sealed('READY') == 0
steps.msg: the press asks for a second and sends nothing
the READY no question held back went out and was sealed after the window's horn

steps.assert: Game.wave == 1 and Game.waves_on_road() == PackedInt32Array([1]) and not Game.is_ready() and not Game.sim.seat(1).ready
steps.msg: it named wave 1 and landed in wave 1: refused, it called nothing and stands as no call

steps.assert: not node('Countdown').text.contains('Ready') and not node('PartyStrip').lines()[0].ends_with('ready') and not node('Ready').get_node('Ring').visible and (not node('Notice').visible or node('Notice').text == 'Call wave 2 now? Press again')
steps.msg: the strip counts no call, my bead and the horn are unlit, and the refusal is not said (the notice still asks only the question)
